content.json:
## Job Finder – Betrieb
Läufe, Quellen, Agent und Review. Nur Zahlen, Status und Dauern, keine Inhalte (siehe `docs/operations.md`, „Logs und Traces“).

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s startswith "{" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event) == "run_finished" | project Zeit = TimeGenerated, Dauer_min = round(todouble(e.duration_seconds) / 60, 1)
content.title: Finder-Läufe in Azure: Dauer in Minuten

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s startswith "{" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event) == "run_summary" | project Zeit = TimeGenerated, Stellen = toint(e.jobs_total), Neu = toint(e.jobs_new), Review_neu = toint(e.review_new), Quellen_teilweise = toint(e.sources_partial), Quellen_fehlgeschlagen = toint(e.sources_failed), Discord_offen = toint(e.outbox_pending), Discord_aeltester_h = todouble(e.outbox_oldest_hours), Steckbriefe_abgebrochen = toint(e.fact_sheets_aborted), Steckbriefe_zweiter_Versuch = toint(e.fact_sheets_retryable) | order by Zeit desc
content.title: Kennzahlen der letzten Läufe

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s startswith "{" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event) == "source_completed" | summarize Laeufe = count(), Teilweise = countif(tostring(e.status) == 'partial'), Fehlgeschlagen = countif(tostring(e.status) == 'failed'), Treffer = round(avg(toint(e.jobs_found)), 0), Sekunden = round(avg(todouble(e.duration_seconds)), 0) by Quelle = tostring(e.source) | order by Fehlgeschlagen desc, Teilweise desc, Treffer desc
content.title: Quellen: Status, Treffer und Dauer je Lauf

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s startswith "{" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event) == "run_summary" | extend Quellen = e.new_by_source | mv-expand bagexpansion = array Quellen | extend Quelle = tostring(Quellen[0]), Neu = toint(Quellen[1]) | summarize Neu = sum(Neu) by Quelle | where Neu > 0 | order by Neu desc
content.title: Neue Stellen je Quelle

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s startswith "{" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event) == "agent_job" | summarize Kosten_EUR = round(sum(todouble(e.cost_eur)), 2) by Tag = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Ergebnis = tostring(e.outcome)
content.title: Agent: Steckbriefe und Kosten je Tag (EUR)

content.query: AppDependencies | where Name == "review_request" | summarize Anfragen = count(), Median_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by Route = tostring(Properties["jobfinder.route"]), Kaltstart = tostring(Properties["jobfinder.first_request"]) | order by Anfragen desc
content.title: Review: Ladezeiten je Schnittstelle (ms)

content.query: AppDependencies | where Name in ("db_connect", "read_recommendations", "read_memory", "build_cards", "read_fact_sheets", "read_document") and AppRoleName == "jobfinder-review" | summarize Median_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by Schritt = Name | order by P95_ms desc
content.title: Review: Dauer der Schritte (ms)
